arguments.summary: Two concurrent operational incidents were resolved: a false positive AV detection of the internal deployment tool 'deploy-agent.exe' and an outdated firewall rule blocking CI/CD pipeline traffic. Both were remediated without impact to production.

timeline.description: AV on WS-DEV-015 flagged 'deploy-agent.exe' as Trojan.GenericKD.46542233.
Firewall rule audit identified rule BLOCK-DEPLOY-EXTERNAL blocking CI/CD outbound traffic.
Development team confirmed false positive; decision to whitelist hash a1b2c3... across organization.
Applied configuration change via T10_config_manager to add hash to AV whitelist.
Deleted firewall rule BLOCK-DEPLOY-EXTERNAL via T9_firewall.
Post-remediation verification confirmed deployment pipeline operational and AV no longer alerts.
